_readme: EVERY PENDING GO-LIVE VALUE LIVES IN THIS FILE.
Fill a value in and the element switches on. Leave it "" and the element is
removed from the page entirely, along with any container it would have left
empty. There is no href="#" fallback anywhere, so the worst case is a missing
link, never a dead one. Run `python3 build.py` after any change.
name: Irony vs. Satyr
description: A small bottle shop in Nove Mesto, Prague. Spirits chosen one at a time, by people who drink them.
_url_note: Where the site actually lives. Canonicals, og:url and sitemap.xml all derive from it, so pointing a real domain at Pages means changing this one line and rebuilding.

_readme: checkout_mode is decided by what you fill in, in this order:
1. stripe_buy_button per product in catalogue.json -> card payment
2. order_form_endpoint -> the cart is sent as an order request
3. neither -> the cart still works, checkout asks you to call in,
and no button ever implies a payment that cannot happen.
delivery_note is shown at checkout and is a legal line, not decoration.
commerce.delivery_note: We sell alcohol. Orders are handed over in person and photo ID is checked at the door - we do not leave alcohol with anyone under 18, and an order that cannot be verified is refunded in full.

analytics._readme: Plausible only, cookieless. Leave blank for no analytics and nothing to disclose. Switching it on means the privacy page needs a line about it.
